parameters.content:
## Setup v2
1. Corre `n8n/schema.sql` en Postgres (incluye leads WhatsApp).
2. Mapea credenciales: Telegram, Postgres, DeepSeek.
3. Speaches, workflow 05 y workflow 06 salen de `app_config` (nodos Consultar app_config → Cargar config). No pegues tokens en el JSON.
4. Acceso: `team_phones.assistant_enabled` + `telegram_user_id`. Quien no esté recibe aviso y se notifica al rol `desarrollo`. Las herramientas de administracion solo llegan al agente de desarrollo. El resto pasa por `assistant_tool_acl`.
5. n8n debe tener HTTPS público (webhook de Telegram y de Evolution).
6. Activa este workflow y prueba texto + nota de voz. Cron avisos = 02. WhatsApp leads = 03+04. Graficas = 05. Certificado PDF = 06.

Las tools del agente son **Postgres Tool** (`postgresTool` v2.6), no el nodo Postgres del flujo.
Modelo: `deepseek-flash` (Chat: maxTokens 4904 / temp 0.2).
Si falla con `reasoning_content` al usar tools, apaga thinking o usa OpenAI Chat Model con base URL `https://api.deepseek.com` y la misma key.

## Memoria
- Tabla `assistant_chat_messages`: ventana corta del agente.
- Tabla `conversation_summaries`: hechos durables.

**Compactar** solo si `COUNT(*) > 40`.
Luego borra y deja las últimas **20** filas
(el contador baja a ~20, no a 0).
Hace falta acumular otra vez ~20 msgs
para volver a pasar 40 y compactar.
Así no compacta en cada mensaje.

Importante: `Guardar resumen` → `Borrar viejos`.

parameters.toolDescription: Crea el seguimiento COMERCIAL: dos avisos a las 10:00 hora Venezuela, t3 (3 dias antes) y day (el dia). NO uses esta tool si el usuario pide seguimiento de llegada, check-in o 'cuando llegue' (usa crear_seguimiento_llegada). estimated_date DEBE ser YYYY-MM-DD. Si el usuario dio un rango, usa la PRIMERA fecha. Si solo dio dia/mes, el año es el vigente en Venezuela (ya viene en el system prompt). Pedir confirmacion antes de llamar. Parametros: client_name, client_phone, estimated_date.
parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS telegram_chat_id,
    btrim($2::text) AS client_name,
    regexp_replace($3::text, '[^0-9+]', '', 'g') AS client_phone,
    $4::date AS estimated_date
),
planned AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    k.kind,
    (
      (CASE WHEN k.kind = 't3' THEN i.estimated_date - 3 ELSE i.estimated_date END)
      + TIME '10:00'
    ) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS fire_at
  FROM input i
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('t3'), ('day')) AS k(kind)
)
INSERT INTO followup_reminders (
  telegram_chat_id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status
)
SELECT
  telegram_chat_id,
  client_name,
  client_phone,
  estimated_date,
  kind,
  fire_at,
  CASE WHEN fire_at <= now() THEN 'skipped' ELSE 'pending' END
FROM planned
WHERE client_name <> '' AND client_phone <> ''
  AND assistant_may($1::bigint, 'crear_seguimiento')
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id, client_phone, estimated_date, kind)
DO UPDATE SET
  client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name,
  fire_at = EXCLUDED.fire_at,
  status = CASE
    WHEN followup_reminders.status = 'sent' THEN followup_reminders.status
    ELSE EXCLUDED.status
  END
RETURNING id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status;

parameters.toolDescription: Crea el seguimiento de LLEGADA / check-in: dos avisos el mismo dia a las 16:00 y 20:00 hora Venezuela (kinds arrival_16 y arrival_20). NO crea t3 ni day. Usar SOLO si el usuario menciona llegada, check-in o 'cuando llegue'. estimated_date DEBE ser YYYY-MM-DD (primera fecha si hay rango; ano vigente Venezuela si solo dia/mes). Pedir confirmacion antes de llamar. Parametros: client_name, client_phone, estimated_date.
parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS telegram_chat_id,
    btrim($2::text) AS client_name,
    regexp_replace($3::text, '[^0-9+]', '', 'g') AS client_phone,
    $4::date AS estimated_date
),
planned AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    k.kind,
    (i.estimated_date + k.hora) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS fire_at
  FROM input i
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES
    ('arrival_16', TIME '16:00'),
    ('arrival_20', TIME '20:00')
  ) AS k(kind, hora)
)
INSERT INTO followup_reminders (
  telegram_chat_id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status
)
SELECT
  telegram_chat_id,
  client_name,
  client_phone,
  estimated_date,
  kind,
  fire_at,
  CASE WHEN fire_at <= now() THEN 'skipped' ELSE 'pending' END
FROM planned
WHERE client_name <> '' AND client_phone <> ''
  AND assistant_may($1::bigint, 'crear_seguimiento_llegada')
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id, client_phone, estimated_date, kind)
DO UPDATE SET
  client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name,
  fire_at = EXCLUDED.fire_at,
  status = CASE
    WHEN followup_reminders.status = 'sent' THEN followup_reminders.status
    ELSE EXCLUDED.status
  END
RETURNING id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status;

parameters.toolDescription: Lista los seguimientos pending o skipped del chat de Telegram. El campo tipo es legible: comercial T-3/dia 10:00 o llegada 16:00/20:00.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date::text AS estimated_date, kind,
       CASE kind
         WHEN 't3' THEN 'comercial T-3 10:00'
         WHEN 'day' THEN 'comercial dia 10:00'
         WHEN 'arrival_16' THEN 'llegada 16:00'
         WHEN 'arrival_20' THEN 'llegada 20:00'
         ELSE kind
       END AS tipo,
       to_char(fire_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS fire_local,
       status
FROM followup_reminders
WHERE telegram_chat_id = $1
  AND status IN ('pending', 'skipped')
ORDER BY estimated_date, kind
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($1::bigint, 'listar_seguimientos');

parameters.toolDescription: Cancela seguimientos pending del chat actual por nombre (min 3 letras) o telefono. Pasa SIEMPRE tipo: llegada (solo 16:00/20:00), comercial (solo t3/day) o todos. Si menciono llegada o check-in, tipo=llegada. Si es el de las 10:00 o T-3, tipo=comercial. tipo=todos SOLO si pidio borrar todas las alertas de ese cliente. Si tipo viene vacio se trata como todos.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS telegram_chat_id,
    btrim($2::text) AS cliente,
    lower(btrim(coalesce($3::text, ''))) AS tipo_raw
),
norm AS (
  SELECT
    telegram_chat_id,
    cliente,
    CASE
      WHEN tipo_raw = '' OR tipo_raw IN ('todos', 'todo', 'all', 'ambas', 'ambos') THEN 'todos'
      WHEN tipo_raw ~ '(llegada|arrival|check.?in)' THEN 'llegada'
      WHEN tipo_raw ~ '(comercial|^t3$|^day$|10:00)' THEN 'comercial'
      ELSE 'ninguno'
    END AS tipo
  FROM params
)
UPDATE followup_reminders f
SET status = 'cancelled'
FROM norm n
WHERE f.telegram_chat_id = n.telegram_chat_id
  AND assistant_may($1::bigint, 'cancelar_seguimiento')
  AND f.status = 'pending'
  AND (
    n.tipo = 'todos'
    OR (n.tipo = 'comercial' AND f.kind IN ('t3', 'day'))
    OR (n.tipo = 'llegada' AND f.kind IN ('arrival_16', 'arrival_20'))
  )
  AND (
    (
      regexp_replace(n.cliente, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> ''
      AND regexp_replace(f.client_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
          LIKE '%' || regexp_replace(n.cliente, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '%'
    )
    OR (
      char_length(n.cliente) >= 3
      AND lower(f.client_name) LIKE '%' || lower(n.cliente) || '%'
    )
  )
RETURNING f.id, f.client_name, f.client_phone, f.kind, f.estimated_date, f.status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message.chat.id, $fromAI('cliente', 'Nombre o telefono del cliente cuyo seguimiento se cancela', 'string'), $fromAI('tipo', 'llegada, comercial o todos. llegada si menciono llegada/check-in; comercial si es T-3 o el de las 10:00; todos solo si pidio borrar todas las alertas de ese cliente', 'string')] }}

parameters.toolDescription: Lista clientes de WhatsApp para difusion o potenciales, con scores 0-100 (potencial, engagement, cierre, silencio), nombre, telefono y etapa. Incluye pregunto_no_concreto, no_respondio y en_proceso callados >12h tras cotizacion. No inventes filas. El asistente DEBE mostrar los scores al usuario.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT display_name, phone, stage,
       score_potencial, score_engagement, score_cierre, score_silencio,
       sentiment_last,
       to_char(last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
       last_reason
FROM leads
WHERE (
stage IN ('pregunto_no_concreto', 'no_respondio')
   OR (
     stage = 'en_proceso'
     AND quoted_at IS NOT NULL
     AND score_cierre < 50
     AND score_potencial >= 40
     AND last_client_at <= now() - interval '12 hours'
   )
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM team_phones t
    WHERE t.active AND t.skip_followup
      AND (
        regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
        OR (
          char_length(regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
          AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
          AND right(regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
        )
      )
  )
ORDER BY score_potencial DESC, last_client_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($1::bigint, 'listar_leads_potenciales');

parameters.toolDescription: Lista clientes de WhatsApp que preguntan mucho y no reservan (engagement alto, cierre bajo, no concreto). Para 'los que preguntan y nunca cierran'.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT display_name, phone, stage, score_engagement, score_cierre,
       client_msg_count,
       to_char(last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
       last_reason
FROM leads
WHERE (
stage <> 'concreto'
  AND score_engagement >= 50
  AND score_cierre < 50
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM team_phones t
    WHERE t.active AND t.skip_followup
      AND (
        regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
        OR (
          char_length(regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
          AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
          AND right(regexp_replace(leads.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
        )
      )
  )
ORDER BY score_engagement DESC, client_msg_count DESC
LIMIT 30
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($1::bigint, 'listar_preguntan_sin_reservar');

parameters.toolDescription: Estadistica del embudo WhatsApp en un mes. conversaciones = chats de clientes (excluye team_phones y lista negra skip_followup). reservaron = cierres del mes EXCLUYENDO lista negra. reservaron_nuevos / reservaron_recurrentes = clientes reales. reservaron_traspaso = equipo_ventas (skip_followup=false), fuera del %. La lista negra NO entra en ningun total. pct_reservaciones = nuevos / conversaciones. periodo YYYY-MM; si no hay mes, mes actual Venezuela.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', d)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS start_at,
    (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
cierres AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(created_at) AS occurred_at
  FROM lead_score_events
  WHERE stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY lead_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT lead_id, occurred_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE from_me
    AND (
      (content_type = 'document' AND body ILIKE '%certificado%')
      OR body ILIKE '%certificado de reserva%'
    )
),
cierres_mes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.lead_id
  FROM cierres c
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE c.occurred_at >= b.start_at AND c.occurred_at < b.end_at
),
blacklist_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN team_phones t ON t.active AND t.skip_followup
  WHERE regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
     OR (
       char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
       AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
       AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
     )
),
team_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN team_phones t ON t.active AND NOT t.skip_followup
  WHERE regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
     OR (
       char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
       AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
       AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
     )
),
cohorte AS (
  SELECT l.id, l.stage
  FROM first_touch f
  JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_leads tl WHERE tl.lead_id = l.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blacklist_leads bl WHERE bl.lead_id = l.id)
)
SELECT
  to_char(timezone('America/Caracas', b.start_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (WHERE bl.lead_id IS NULL)::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE bl.lead_id IS NULL
      AND tl.lead_id IS NULL
      AND ft.first_at >= b.start_at AND ft.first_at < b.end_at
  )::int AS reservaron_nuevos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE bl.lead_id IS NULL
      AND tl.lead_id IS NULL
      AND ft.first_at < b.start_at
  )::int AS reservaron_recurrentes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE bl.lead_id IS NULL
      AND tl.lead_id IS NOT NULL
  )::int AS reservaron_traspaso,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'no_respondio')::int AS no_respondieron,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'en_proceso')::int AS en_proceso,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
      WHERE bl.lead_id IS NULL
        AND tl.lead_id IS NULL
        AND ft.first_at >= b.start_at AND ft.first_at < b.end_at
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT co.id), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_reservaciones
FROM bounds b
LEFT JOIN cohorte co ON true
LEFT JOIN cierres_mes cm ON true
LEFT JOIN first_touch ft ON ft.lead_id = cm.lead_id
LEFT JOIN team_leads tl ON tl.lead_id = cm.lead_id
LEFT JOIN blacklist_leads bl ON bl.lead_id = cm.lead_id
GROUP BY b.start_at
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($2::bigint, 'estadisticas_leads_mes');

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$fromAI('periodo', 'Mes a consultar en YYYY-MM. Si el usuario no indica mes, usa el mes actual de Venezuela', 'string'), $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message.from.id] }}

parameters.toolDescription: Lista por nombre y telefono los leads de un mes. tipo OBLIGATORIO: concretaron (nuevo+recurrente+traspaso, sin lista negra), no_concretaron, traspasos (solo equipo_ventas con cierre), lista_negra (solo skip_followup), atendidos (todo excepto lista negra). Campo origen: nuevo, recurrente, traspaso, equipo, sin_cierre, lista_negra. periodo YYYY-MM; si no hay mes, mes actual Venezuela. No inventes filas.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $2::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($2::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', d)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS start_at,
    (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
cierres AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(created_at) AS occurred_at
  FROM lead_score_events
  WHERE stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY lead_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT lead_id, occurred_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE from_me
    AND (
      (content_type = 'document' AND body ILIKE '%certificado%')
      OR body ILIKE '%certificado de reserva%'
    )
),
cierres_mes AS (
  SELECT c.lead_id, MIN(c.occurred_at) AS cierre_at
  FROM cierres c
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE c.occurred_at >= b.start_at AND c.occurred_at < b.end_at
  GROUP BY c.lead_id
),
blacklist_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN team_phones t ON t.active AND t.skip_followup
  WHERE regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
     OR (
       char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
       AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
       AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
     )
),
team_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN team_phones t ON t.active AND NOT t.skip_followup
  WHERE regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = t.phone
     OR (
       char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
       AND char_length(t.phone) >= 10
       AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(t.phone, 10)
     )
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timezone('America/Caracas', b.start_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.display_name), ''), '(sin nombre)') AS display_name,
    l.phone,
    l.stage,
    CASE
      WHEN bl.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'lista_negra'
      WHEN tl.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND cm.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'traspaso'
      WHEN tl.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'equipo'
      WHEN cm.lead_id IS NOT NULL AND f.first_at < b.start_at THEN 'recurrente'
      WHEN cm.lead_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'nuevo'
      ELSE 'sin_cierre'
    END AS origen,
    tp.name AS equipo_nombre,
    tp.team_tag AS equipo_tag,
    tp.skip_followup AS en_lista_negra,
    l.score_potencial,
    l.score_engagement,
    l.score_cierre,
    to_char(f.first_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS first_touch_local,
    to_char(cm.cierre_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS cierre_local,
    to_char(l.last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
    l.last_reason
  FROM leads l
  JOIN first_touch f ON f.lead_id = l.id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  LEFT JOIN cierres_mes cm ON cm.lead_id = l.id
  LEFT JOIN blacklist_leads bl ON bl.lead_id = l.id
  LEFT JOIN team_leads tl ON tl.lead_id = l.id
  LEFT JOIN team_phones tp ON tp.active
    AND (
      regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = tp.phone
      OR (
        char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
        AND char_length(tp.phone) >= 10
        AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(tp.phone, 10)
      )
    )
  WHERE (f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at)
     OR cm.lead_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM base
WHERE CASE
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('lista_negra', 'lista negra', 'blacklist', 'bloqueados')
    THEN origen = 'lista_negra'
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('concretaron', 'concreto', 'reservaron', 'reservas')
    THEN origen IN ('nuevo', 'recurrente', 'traspaso')
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('no_concretaron', 'no concreto', 'no_concreto', 'no reservaron')
    THEN origen = 'sin_cierre'
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('traspasos', 'traspaso', 'equipo', 'equipo_ventas')
    THEN origen = 'traspaso'
  ELSE origen <> 'lista_negra'
END
ORDER BY CASE origen
  WHEN 'lista_negra' THEN 0
  WHEN 'traspaso' THEN 1
  WHEN 'recurrente' THEN 2
  WHEN 'nuevo' THEN 3
  WHEN 'equipo' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END,
cierre_local DESC NULLS LAST,
last_client_local DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($3::bigint, 'listar_leads_reporte');

parameters.toolDescription: Ficha de un lead WhatsApp por telefono o nombre. Devuelve first_touch, primer concreto, cada certificado (resumen 1a hoja: huesped, fechas, habitacion, monto) y avisos de seguimiento. Usar si piden revisar un cliente, ver si reservo, o hay duda de una reserva. No inventes filas.
parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    regexp_replace($1::text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS digits,
    lower(btrim($1::text)) AS q
),
matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id
  FROM leads l
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN followup_reminders r
    ON regexp_replace(r.client_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
       LIKE '%' || regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '%'
  WHERE (
    char_length(p.digits) >= 8
    AND regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || p.digits || '%'
  )
  OR (
    char_length(p.digits) < 8
    AND char_length(p.q) >= 3
    AND (
      lower(l.display_name) LIKE '%' || p.q || '%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(r.client_name, '')) LIKE '%' || p.q || '%'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages m
        WHERE m.lead_id = l.id
          AND m.from_me
          AND m.content_type = 'document'
          AND lower(m.body) LIKE '%' || p.q || '%'
      )
    )
  )
  LIMIT 5
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT m.id AS lead_id, MIN(w.occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM matched m
  JOIN whatsapp_messages w ON w.lead_id = m.id AND NOT w.from_me
  GROUP BY m.id
),
primer_concreto AS (
  SELECT m.id AS lead_id, MIN(e.created_at) AS closed_at
  FROM matched m
  JOIN lead_score_events e ON e.lead_id = m.id AND e.stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY m.id
),
eventos AS (
  SELECT m.id AS lead_id, MIN(e.created_at) AS occurred_at,
         'primer_concreto'::text AS evento,
         'Paso a concreto'::text AS detalle
  FROM matched m
  JOIN lead_score_events e ON e.lead_id = m.id AND e.stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY m.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.lead_id, w.occurred_at, 'certificado', CASE
         WHEN w.body LIKE '[Certificado]%' THEN LEFT(w.body, 700)
         ELSE LEFT(w.body, 220)
       END
  FROM matched m
  JOIN whatsapp_messages w ON w.lead_id = m.id
  WHERE w.from_me
    AND (
      (w.content_type = 'document' AND w.body ILIKE '%certificado%')
      OR w.body ILIKE '%certificado de reserva%'
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.id, r.created_at, 'aviso_' || r.kind,
         COALESCE(r.client_name, '') || ' | ' || r.status || ' | llegada ' || COALESCE(to_char(r.estimated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '')
  FROM matched m
  JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.id
  JOIN followup_reminders r
    ON regexp_replace(r.client_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
       LIKE '%' || regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '%'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ev.evento, 'ficha') AS tipo_fila,
  l.id AS lead_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.display_name), ''), '(sin nombre)') AS display_name,
  l.phone,
  l.stage,
  to_char(ft.first_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS first_touch_local,
  to_char(pc.closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS primer_concreto_local,
  to_char(ev.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS evento_at,
  ev.detalle
FROM matched m
JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.id
LEFT JOIN first_touch ft ON ft.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN primer_concreto pc ON pc.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN eventos ev ON ev.lead_id = l.id
ORDER BY l.id, ev.occurred_at NULLS LAST
LIMIT 40
) acl_rows
WHERE assistant_may($2::bigint, 'consultar_ficha_lead');

parameters.toolDescription: Agrega o quita un telefono de la lista negra WhatsApp (skip_followup). accion OBLIGATORIA: agregar | quitar. telefono en digitos (ej 58412...). nombre opcional al agregar. notes opcional. Al agregar anula scores del lead si existe. Pedir confirmacion antes de agregar/quitar. Para solo ver la lista usa listar_lista_negra.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    lower(btrim(COALESCE($1::text, ''))) AS accion,
    regexp_replace(COALESCE($2::text, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS phone,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($3::text, '')), ''), 'Lista negra') AS name,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($4::text, '')), '') AS notes
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO team_phones (phone, name, team_tag, skip_followup, notes, active)
  SELECT p.phone, p.name, 'lista_negra', true, p.notes, true
  FROM params p
  WHERE assistant_may($5::bigint, 'gestionar_lista_negra')
    AND p.accion IN ('agregar', 'add', 'bloquear', 'alta')
    AND char_length(p.phone) >= 10
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
    skip_followup = true,
    active = true,
    name = CASE
      WHEN EXCLUDED.name <> 'Lista negra' THEN EXCLUDED.name
      ELSE team_phones.name
    END,
    notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.notes, team_phones.notes),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING phone, name, team_tag, skip_followup, 'agregado'::text AS resultado
),
reset_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l SET
    stage = 'en_proceso',
    score_potencial = 0,
    score_engagement = 0,
    score_cierre = 0,
    score_silencio = 0,
    last_reason = 'Numero en lista negra (skip_followup): score anulado',
    updated_at = now()
  FROM params p
  WHERE assistant_may($5::bigint, 'gestionar_lista_negra')
    AND p.accion IN ('agregar', 'add', 'bloquear', 'alta')
    AND char_length(p.phone) >= 10
    AND (
      regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = p.phone
      OR (
        char_length(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')) >= 10
        AND right(regexp_replace(l.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = right(p.phone, 10)
      )
    )
  RETURNING l.phone AS lead_phone
),
removed AS (
  UPDATE team_phones t SET
    skip_followup = false,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM params p
  WHERE assistant_may($5::bigint, 'gestionar_lista_negra')
    AND p.accion IN ('quitar', 'remove', 'desbloquear', 'baja')
    AND char_length(p.phone) >= 10
    AND t.active
    AND (
      t.phone = p.phone
      OR (char_length(t.phone) >= 10 AND right(t.phone, 10) = right(p.phone, 10))
    )
  RETURNING t.phone, t.name, t.team_tag, t.skip_followup, 'quitado'::text AS resultado
),
invalid AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.phone, ''), '(sin telefono)') AS phone,
    p.name,
    'lista_negra'::text AS team_tag,
    false AS skip_followup,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assistant_may($5::bigint, 'gestionar_lista_negra') THEN 'sin_permiso'
      WHEN p.accion NOT IN (
        'agregar', 'add', 'bloquear', 'alta',
        'quitar', 'remove', 'desbloquear', 'baja'
      ) THEN 'accion_invalida'
      WHEN char_length(p.phone) < 10 THEN 'telefono_invalido'
      ELSE 'sin_cambios'
    END AS resultado
  FROM params p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upserted)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM removed)
)
SELECT phone, name, team_tag, skip_followup, resultado FROM upserted
UNION ALL
SELECT phone, name, team_tag, skip_followup, resultado FROM removed
UNION ALL
SELECT phone, name, team_tag, skip_followup, resultado FROM invalid;

parameters.toolDescription: Lista el equipo en team_phones: nombre, telefono, rol, active, skip_followup, telegram_user_id y assistant_enabled. Sirve para ver datos faltantes de WhatsApp. No inventes filas.

Cambia permisos de herramientas. accion: listar, conceder, revocar o solo. Si pasas persona (nombre), el cambio es SOLO de esa persona y no del rol. solo deja a esa persona exactamente con las tool_name separadas por coma y bloquea el resto. Si pasas team_tag y no persona, el cambio es de todo el rol: desarrollo, equipo_ventas, asesora o asistente. tool_name es el nombre exacto. Solo desarrollo.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    lower(btrim(COALESCE($1::text, ''))) AS accion,
    NULLIF(lower(btrim(COALESCE($2::text, ''))), '') AS team_tag,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($3::text, '')), '') AS tool_name,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE($4::text, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint AS caller_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE($5::text, '')), '') AS persona
),
caller AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM team_phones d
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE d.telegram_user_id = p.caller_id
    AND d.team_tag = 'desarrollo'
    AND d.assistant_enabled
    AND assistant_may(p.caller_id, 'gestionar_permisos_herramientas')
),
wanted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT btrim(token) AS tool_name
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(p.tool_name, ''), '\s*,\s*') AS token
  WHERE btrim(token) <> ''
),
person_hits AS (
  SELECT t.id, t.name, t.team_tag, t.telegram_user_id
  FROM team_phones t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE p.persona IS NOT NULL
    AND char_length(regexp_replace(btrim(p.persona), '[%_]', '', 'g')) >= 3
    AND (
      lower(btrim(t.name)) = lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p.persona), '[%_]', '', 'g'))
      OR lower(btrim(t.name)) LIKE lower(regexp_replace(btrim(p.persona), '[%_]', '', 'g')) || ' %'
    )
),
catalog AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tool_name FROM assistant_tool_acl
),
gate AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caller) THEN 'solo_desarrollador'
    WHEN (SELECT persona FROM params) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM person_hits) = 0 THEN 'sin_persona'
    WHEN (SELECT persona FROM params) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM person_hits) > 1 THEN 'nombre_ambiguo'
    WHEN (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('conceder', 'dar', 'permitir', 'revocar', 'quitar')
      AND (SELECT persona FROM params) IS NULL
      AND (SELECT team_tag FROM params) IS NULL THEN 'falta_destino'
    WHEN (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('conceder', 'dar', 'permitir', 'revocar', 'quitar', 'solo', 'limitar')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wanted) THEN 'falta_herramienta'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM wanted w
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog c WHERE c.tool_name = w.tool_name)
    ) THEN 'herramienta_desconocida'
    WHEN (SELECT persona FROM params) IS NULL
      AND (SELECT team_tag FROM params) = 'desarrollo'
      AND (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('revocar', 'quitar')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wanted w WHERE w.tool_name = 'gestionar_permisos_herramientas')
      THEN 'no_revocar_permisos_desarrollador'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_hits h WHERE h.team_tag = 'desarrollo')
      AND (
        (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('solo', 'limitar')
        OR (
          (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('revocar', 'quitar')
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wanted w WHERE w.tool_name = 'gestionar_permisos_herramientas')
        )
      ) THEN 'no_revocar_permisos_desarrollador'
    WHEN (SELECT accion FROM params) NOT IN (
      'listar', 'ver', 'conceder', 'dar', 'permitir', 'revocar', 'quitar', 'solo', 'limitar'
    ) THEN 'accion_invalida'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS bloqueo
),
listed_role AS (
  SELECT acl.team_tag, NULL::text AS persona, acl.tool_name, true AS permitido, 'rol'::text AS origen, 'listado'::text AS resultado, NULL::bigint AS telegram_user_id
  FROM assistant_tool_acl acl
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('listar', 'ver')
    AND p.persona IS NULL
    AND (p.team_tag IS NULL OR acl.team_tag = p.team_tag)
),
listed_person AS (
  SELECT
    h.team_tag,
    h.name AS persona,
    c.tool_name,
    COALESCE(
      ap.allowed,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM assistant_tool_acl acl
        WHERE acl.team_tag = h.team_tag AND acl.tool_name = c.tool_name
      )
    ) AS permitido,
    CASE WHEN ap.team_phone_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'persona' ELSE 'rol' END AS origen,
    'listado'::text AS resultado,
    h.telegram_user_id
  FROM person_hits h
  CROSS JOIN catalog c
  LEFT JOIN assistant_tool_person ap
    ON ap.team_phone_id = h.id AND ap.tool_name = c.tool_name
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('listar', 'ver')
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM person_hits) = 1
),
granted_role AS (
  INSERT INTO assistant_tool_acl (team_tag, tool_name)
  SELECT p.team_tag, w.tool_name
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN wanted w
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.persona IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('conceder', 'dar', 'permitir')
    AND p.team_tag IN ('desarrollo', 'equipo_ventas', 'asesora', 'asistente')
  ON CONFLICT (team_tag, tool_name) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING team_tag, tool_name
),
revoked_role AS (
  DELETE FROM assistant_tool_acl acl
  USING params p, wanted w
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.persona IS NULL
    AND p.accion IN ('revocar', 'quitar')
    AND acl.team_tag = p.team_tag
    AND acl.tool_name = w.tool_name
    AND NOT (acl.team_tag = 'desarrollo' AND acl.tool_name = 'gestionar_permisos_herramientas')
  RETURNING acl.team_tag, acl.tool_name
),
person_write AS (
  INSERT INTO assistant_tool_person (team_phone_id, tool_name, allowed)
  SELECT
    h.id,
    c.tool_name,
    CASE
      WHEN p.accion IN ('solo', 'limitar') THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM wanted w WHERE w.tool_name = c.tool_name
      )
      ELSE p.accion IN ('conceder', 'dar', 'permitir')
    END
  FROM person_hits h
  CROSS JOIN params p
  JOIN catalog c ON (
    p.accion IN ('solo', 'limitar')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wanted w WHERE w.tool_name = c.tool_name)
  )
  WHERE (SELECT bloqueo FROM gate) IS NULL
    AND p.persona IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM person_hits) = 1
    AND p.accion IN ('conceder', 'dar', 'permitir', 'revocar', 'quitar', 'solo', 'limitar')
  ON CONFLICT (team_phone_id, tool_name) DO UPDATE SET allowed = EXCLUDED.allowed
  RETURNING team_phone_id, tool_name, allowed
),
person_result AS (
  SELECT
    h.team_tag,
    h.name AS persona,
    w.tool_name,
    w.allowed AS permitido,
    'persona'::text AS origen,
    CASE
      WHEN (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('solo', 'limitar') AND w.allowed THEN 'permitido'
      WHEN (SELECT accion FROM params) IN ('solo', 'limitar') THEN 'bloqueado'
      WHEN w.allowed THEN 'concedido'
      ELSE 'revocado'
    END AS resultado,
    h.telegram_user_id
  FROM person_write w
  JOIN person_hits h ON h.id = w.team_phone_id
),
blocked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.team_tag, (SELECT h.team_tag FROM person_hits h LIMIT 1)) AS team_tag,
    p.persona,
    p.tool_name,
    NULL::boolean AS permitido,
    NULL::text AS origen,
    COALESCE(g.bloqueo, 'sin_cambios') AS resultado,
    (SELECT h.telegram_user_id FROM person_hits h LIMIT 1) AS telegram_user_id
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN gate g
  WHERE g.bloqueo IS NOT NULL
     OR (
       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listed_role)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listed_person)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM granted_role)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM revoked_role)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_write)
     )
)
SELECT team_tag, persona, tool_name, permitido, origen, resultado, telegram_user_id FROM listed_role
UNION ALL
SELECT team_tag, persona, tool_name, permitido, origen, resultado, telegram_user_id FROM listed_person
UNION ALL
SELECT team_tag, NULL::text, tool_name, true, 'rol', 'concedido', NULL::bigint FROM granted_role
UNION ALL
SELECT team_tag, NULL::text, tool_name, false, 'rol', 'revocado', NULL::bigint FROM revoked_role
UNION ALL
SELECT team_tag, persona, tool_name, permitido, origen, resultado, telegram_user_id FROM person_result
UNION ALL
SELECT team_tag, persona, tool_name, permitido, origen, resultado, telegram_user_id FROM blocked;

INSERT INTO assistant_access_requests (
  telegram_user_id, display_name, username, status, requested_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  $1::bigint,
  COALESCE($2::text, ''),
  NULLIF($3::text, ''),
  'pending',
  now(),
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  display_name = CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(btrim(EXCLUDED.display_name), '') IS NULL THEN assistant_access_requests.display_name
    ELSE EXCLUDED.display_name
  END,
  username = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(EXCLUDED.username), ''), assistant_access_requests.username),
  status = 'pending',
  requested_at = now(),
  updated_at = now();
